segments.title: Closing your last tab keeps the window
segments.body: A window with four pinned tiles, all asleep, and one tab. Click the tab's ✕: the window stays, New Tab takes its place and the tiles are untouched, as in Arc. 0.2.43-nightly.4 asked “Close 1 tab?”, then closed the window and its tiles with it.
segments.note: Before dialog drawn from what nightly.4 logged

segments.title: Glass without outlines
segments.body: Point at a tab in the sidebar, then at Pin on its card, in dark mode over a colourful page. The card and its Pin, Bookmark and Split buttons are now clear liquid glass with no outline. 0.2.43-nightly.4 drew a flat, opaque card with a hairline edge.
